{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Confirm the presence of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f'Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}')

# Check if any revenue values are malformed (e.g., missing, invalid)
print('\nUnique revenue values (first 10):')
print(sales['revenue'].unique()[:10])

# Check for any non-numeric strings
non_numeric = sales[~sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').str.isnumeric()]
print(f'\nRows with non-numeric revenue: {len(non_numeric)}')

# Show the non-numeric rows
if len(non_numeric) > 0:
    print(non_numeric[['revenue']].head())"}
